∀ {L : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Layout} {M : Minidregg.Theory.CellState.Materializer L Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {portal : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Portal} {authState : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.AuthState} {pre : Minidregg.Theory.CellState.Materialized M} (leg : Minidregg.Kernel.TypedCellHyperedge.Leg portal authState pre) (presentationRoot : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest), (Minidregg.Compiler.TypedCellHyperedgeArtifact.legArtifact leg presentationRoot).effectDigest = leg.request.effectsDigest.value

∀ {L : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Layout} {M : Minidregg.Theory.CellState.Materializer L Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {portal : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Portal} {authState : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.AuthState} {pre : Minidregg.Theory.CellState.Materialized M} (leg : Minidregg.Kernel.TypedCellHyperedge.Leg portal authState pre) (presentationRoot : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest), Minidregg.Theory.AuthorizationDeclaration.decodeRequest (Minidregg.Compiler.TypedCellHyperedgeArtifact.legArtifact leg presentationRoot).request = Option.some ⟨leg.kind, leg.request⟩

∀ {L : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Layout} {M : Minidregg.Theory.CellState.Materializer L Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {portal : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Portal} {projection : Minidregg.Kernel.TypedCellHyperedge.AuthorizationProjection L} {Incidence : Type z} (declaration : Minidregg.Kernel.TypedCellHyperedge.Declaration L M portal projection Incidence) (presentationRoot : Incidence → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest), (Minidregg.Compiler.TypedCellHyperedgeArtifact.ofDeclaration declaration presentationRoot).apex = declaration.apex.value

∀ {L : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Layout} {M : Minidregg.Theory.CellState.Materializer L Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {portal : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Portal} {projection : Minidregg.Kernel.TypedCellHyperedge.AuthorizationProjection L} {Incidence : Type z} (declaration : Minidregg.Kernel.TypedCellHyperedge.Declaration L M portal projection Incidence) (presentationRoot : Incidence → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (index : ℕ) (incidence : Incidence), declaration.composition.order[index]? = Option.some incidence → (Minidregg.Compiler.TypedCellHyperedgeArtifact.ofDeclaration declaration presentationRoot).legs[index]? = Option.some (Minidregg.Compiler.TypedCellHyperedgeArtifact.legArtifact (declaration.legs incidence) (presentationRoot incidence))

∀ {L : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Layout} {M : Minidregg.Theory.CellState.Materializer L Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {portal : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Portal} {projection : Minidregg.Kernel.TypedCellHyperedge.AuthorizationProjection L} {Incidence : Type z} (declaration : Minidregg.Kernel.TypedCellHyperedge.Declaration L M portal projection Incidence) (presentationRoot : Incidence → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest), (Minidregg.Compiler.TypedCellHyperedgeArtifact.ofDeclaration declaration presentationRoot).preRoot = declaration.pre.root.value
